errors.text: The proposed intervention is generic data-driven property prediction rather than a machine-learning interatomic potential used with free-energy perturbation to replace EAM-based thermodynamic integration.
It omits the relevant free-energy physics, including electronic excitation and solid-state short-range-order contributions to melting temperature.
None of the cited evidence demonstrates machine-learning prediction of HEA melting properties or supports the claimed accuracy and efficiency improvement.
The predicted improvement is not quantitative and cannot be compared with the target benchmarks of approximately 80% resource savings, 20-fold speedup, or sub-0.5 meV/atom free-energy agreement.
The falsification rule does not define an alloy split, error threshold, uncertainty treatment, or comparison against a specified computational baseline.
